- Requirement: sub-200ms p99 for rerank loop end-to-end; peak throughput ~5k requests/min during rush windows.
- Preference for private/VPC deployment; procurement wants KMS + audit logs + regional residency in us-west.

- Latency/throughput targets: p99 <200ms for rerank path, sustained 3–5k req/min during peak, cost target <$0.01 per dispatched route.
- Model preferences: Llama-family quantized variants for rerank, smaller chat model for driver assistant.
- Routing/fallback needs: prefer automatic fallback to lower-cost model during peak; ability to pin model versions per region.
- Compliance: strict audit logs, residency in us-west, SSO/SAML for all console access.
